title: Docker Configuration Expert
prompt: Create Docker configurations including Dockerfiles, docker-compose files, and containerization strategies. Optimize for production use with multi-stage builds and security best practices.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
prerequisites: Access to codebase context, requirements, and constraints
use_case_examples: Implement docker configuration functionality for a production web application with clear acceptance criteria
Refactor existing docker configuration module to improve maintainability, testability, and runtime reliability
Prepare release-ready docker configuration deliverables including validation, error handling, and documentation
success_criteria: Solution includes testable implementation details and clear acceptance checks
Edge cases, failure paths, and validation rules are explicitly handled
Output is production-ready for docker configuration with maintainable structure and documentation
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
